action.mutates: on the node: creates /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 if root has none, copies its public half to /run/p8test-sync/root.pub (handed to the peer), and appends "$P8_PEER_ADDR p8test.example.invalid" to /etc/hosts

on the peer: creates the account p8testuser with the node root's public key as its only authorized key, and /srv/p8test (owned by it) with a.txt, sub/b.txt, gone.txt and big.bin (6 MiB from /dev/urandom)

action.mutates: on the node: runs /opt/puppet-infrastructure/bin/sync-sync.sh once as root (rsync over ssh to the peer), which creates /var/tmp/p8test-sync/p8test.example.invalid-p8test; its exit status and duration go to /run/p8test-sync
on the node, runs /opt/puppet-infrastructure/bin/sync-sync.sh a second time as root; its exit status goes to /run/p8test-sync/run2.rc

outcomes.outcome: the per-tag script is installed root:root 0755 with the parameters, and parses
the local user's crontab runs it daily at hour:minute
a run mirrors the remote host's directory into <localdir>/<host><suffix> over ssh as the remote user
the bandwidth limit (Mbit/s converted to rsync's MiB/s) slows the transfer
a file removed on the remote host is removed locally by the next run (--delete)

uncovered.why: a run would have to wait for 03:17; the crontab entry is checked and the script it names is run by hand

outcomes.outcome: several hosts, other ports, no limit, another local user
